suggestions.reason: The case-3 prompt (unlike case-1/2) does not explicitly assert G1/G3 已通过. The original run interpreted the missing gate-status as missing upstream artifacts and routed to S1; the rerun assumed gates passed and routed to S4. To make the route deterministic across runs, the prompt should state G1/G3 status explicitly, as the positive cases do.
No expectation checks the raw output contract (bare JSON, no preamble, no fence). The rerun artifact is clean, but the eval set would not catch a fence/preamble regression if it occurred.

eval_feedback.overall: Core negative-case behavior is fully correct in the graded rerun (null artifact, no G4 pass, no fabricated mastery/frontier, explicit evidence-absence recording, route stays at S4). All six expectations pass against outputs/result.gclaude-rerun.json.
